bug_info.bug_desc: When a page-table walker (PTW) access exception occurs during an instruction fetch, the MMU incorrectly reports the physical address (ptw_bad_paddr) as the faulting address in the tval field of the instruction access fault exception. According to the RISC-V privileged specification, when page-based virtual memory is enabled, mtval/stval must contain the faulting virtual address, even for physical-memory access-fault exceptions.
bug_info.fix_hint: Modify the instruction access fault exception generation in the instr_interface block of mmu.sv to use the faulting virtual address (update_vaddr) instead of the physical address (ptw_bad_paddr) for the tval field when ptw_access_exception is asserted.

bug_info.bug_desc: When a PMP violation occurs during a store operation, the MMU incorrectly reports the physical address (lsu_paddr_o) as the faulting address in the tval field of the store access fault exception. According to the RISC-V privileged specification, when page-based virtual memory is enabled, mtval/stval must contain the faulting virtual address, even for physical-memory access-fault exceptions.
bug_info.fix_hint: Modify the store access fault exception generation in the data_interface block of mmu.sv to use the faulting virtual address (lsu_vaddr_q) instead of the physical address (lsu_paddr_o) for the tval field when a PMP violation is detected.

bug_info.fix_hint: Modify the load access fault exception generation in the data_interface block of mmu.sv to use the faulting virtual address (lsu_vaddr_q) instead of the physical address (lsu_paddr_o) for the tval field when a PMP violation is detected.
